sources.snippet: How to use Nano Banana right now The simplest path is the Gemini app. Open it, select the banana emoji Create images tool from the menu, and start prompting. Free users get the Nano Banana 2 (Fast) model. Google AI Plus, Pro, and Ultra subscribers get higher quotas and access to Pro mode, which uses Nano Banana Pro for maximum quality.
